flags.issue: "Backfilled" scans mistranslated as "retroalimentadas" (fed-back/feedback). Source Note: "backfilled and public-tool scans never do"; translation: "Las ejecuciones retroalimentadas y los escaneos de la herramienta pública nunca lo hacen." Backfill = retroactive score generation for past builds, semantically unrelated to feedback.
flags.suggested_action: Replace "retroalimentadas" with "retroactivas" or "de relleno": e.g. "Las puntuaciones de relleno y los escaneos de la herramienta pública nunca lo hacen."

flags.issue: UI button "Copy prompt to fix" translated to "Copiar prompt para corregir" in body text (line 62). The actual in-product button label is English; readers following the docs will see the English label in the dashboard.
flags.suggested_action: Keep the button name in English: "botón **Copy prompt to fix**", optionally with Spanish in parentheses.

flags.issue: "AI Score" (Jamdesk-branded product name) is inconsistently rendered: card titles and link text keep "AI Score" but the June 2026 Update body translates it as "Puntuación IA" (e.g. "Tu documentación recibe una Puntuación IA en cada build"). Source: "Your docs get an AI Score on every build."
flags.suggested_action: Use the untranslated product name "AI Score" consistently throughout all body text, matching the dashboard label and page title.

flags.issue: In-product button "Authorize Bot Account" translated to "Autorizar cuenta de bot" and "Copy prompt to fix" translated to "Copiar prompt para corregir" in changelog body. These English button labels are shown verbatim in the English-language dashboard UI.
flags.suggested_action: Retain English UI button names in bold, optionally followed by Spanish translation in parentheses.

flags.issue: Troubleshooting heading '"¿Ya tienes Jamdesk instalado?"' translates the verbatim UI dialog string "Already have Jamdesk installed?" shown in the English dashboard. Readers will not find the translated text in the UI.
flags.suggested_action: Retain the English UI string as the heading with a Spanish descriptor in parentheses or prose, e.g.: ### "Already have Jamdesk installed?"

flags.issue: Frontmatter description is approximately 163 characters: "Controla títulos, descripciones y metaetiquetas para motores de búsqueda y previsualizaciones sociales. Jamdesk genera sitemaps e imágenes Open Graph automáticamente." Exceeds the 160-char soft limit.
flags.suggested_action: Shorten to ≤155 chars while preserving meaning, e.g. "Controla títulos, descripciones y metaetiquetas para SEO y redes sociales. Jamdesk genera sitemaps e imágenes Open Graph automáticamente."

flags.issue: Dashboard UI navigation path "Project Settings → Configuration Highlights" translated to "Configuración del proyecto → Aspectos destacados de la configuración" in the opening Tip. The actual dashboard is in English, so Spanish-speaking readers following along may not find the translated labels.
flags.suggested_action: Add English labels in parentheses or keep them in English: **Project Settings → Configuration Highlights** (Configuración del proyecto → Aspectos destacados de la configuración).

flags.issue: GTM UI step labels (Tags→New, GA4 Configuration, All Pages, Preview) translated to Spanish (Etiquetas→Nueva, Configuración de GA4, Todas las páginas, Preview). GTM does localize its UI per browser language, but the exact Spanish wording may differ from the translation used here.
flags.suggested_action: Verify against the actual Spanish GTM interface labels, or retain English UI strings with Spanish in parentheses for accuracy.
